source.snippet: Can anyone recommend a good password manager solution for teams/organisations that is: Free or affordable, Preferably self-hosted, Secure enterprise-friendly. I've been looking into Vaultwarden and Passbolt, but I'm still researching how secure and production-ready they are as open-source platforms.

problem_statement: Small IT teams managing Microsoft-centric environments need a self-hosted, enterprise-grade password manager that is affordable and demonstrably production-ready, but lack clear guidance on security maturity of available open-source options like Vaultwarden and Passbolt.
target_segment: IT administrators and small-to-mid-size businesses managing shared credentials, particularly in Microsoft ecosystems
notes: Recurring question pattern across IT forums. Gap is not the software itself but a trusted, opinionated deployment guide or managed hosting layer on top of open-source tools. Potential SaaS or productized setup service.
